newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY EASIER IN DULL TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY EASIER IN DULL TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Monday easier against most hard currencies but dealers said the unit was hardly moved from its morning levels amid a dull interbank session.
"There was only very thin trade today and nothing much happened to the local dollar. It hardly moved at all during the day," one dealer said.
The unit finished at 10.2300/2700 against the U.S. dollar, unchanged from the morning, although this was a drop from Friday's 10.1900/2600.
On the crosses, it registered mild losses against pound sterling to 15.9680/16.0310 from 15.9500/16.0670 and edged up on the mark to 6.8610/8900 from 6.8550/9040.
Against South Africa's rand, the Zimbabwe dollar weakened to 2.2740/2840 from 2.2610/2790.
